note: hu.wikipedia.org's Bicske–Székesfehérvár-vasútvonal article documents the only MÁV national line actually running through Felcsút as line 6 (Bicske–Székesfehérvár), not 306 - the code '306' does not appear anywhere in that article. The article also documents that a separate, later-built narrow-gauge heritage/tourist line (a 'kisvásut', reusing part of the old alignment and the old Felcsút station building, with its own 'Felcsút (kisvasút megálló)' stop) now runs through the same area - which, if that is what the OSM node actually represents, falls outside this phase's approved domain scope (review-policy.json: municipal/heritage narrow-gauge lines are not MÁV/GYSEV national network-statement infrastructure). Either way, independent verification does not corroborate '306' as a genuine national line code at this location; it actively contradicts the OSM-derived candidate rather than confirming it. Rejected rather than left at OSM_EVIDENCE_ACCEPTED, since the contradiction is specific and documented, not merely 'unconfirmed'.
